title: Count Triplets with Even XOR Set Bits I
summary: Count triplets from arrays a, b, and c where the bitwise XOR of each triplet's elements has an even number of set bits.
statement: Count triplets from arrays a, b, and c where the bitwise XOR of each triplet's elements has an even number of set bits.
constraints: Choose one value from each of arrays a, b, and c.
XOR the three values and count the one bits in the result.
Return the number of triplets whose XOR has an even set-bit count.
reference_solution:
def count_even_popcount_xor_triplets(a,b,c):
    return sum((x^y^z).bit_count()%2==0 for x in a for y in b for z in c)
hints: The source-I limits permit direct Cartesian enumeration.
For each triplet compute XOR and integer bit_count.
Count it when that count modulo two is zero.
Every index triplet appears once in the three nested loops and is classified by the exact predicate.
editorial: Every index triplet appears once in the three nested loops and is classified by the exact predicate.

tests.explanation: One XOR two XOR three is zero, whose set-bit count is even, so one triplet qualifies.
Both index-distinct choices from a produce zero XOR, so two triplets qualify.
